notes: Chained recovery: decode a letter-substitution cryptogram with a clued alphabet mapping (C-03818c40), extract the passcode with end-of-note/punctuation edge cases, unlock an openssl key box, then decrypt EVERY ciphertext block with an ARX cipher and write one plaintext per line in order (C-9e5ae912). Reusable tool re-run on hidden scenarios with different notes, mappings, passcodes, keys, and bundle lengths; exported helpers are unit-probed. Nonzero dependent_stages (note -> passcode -> key -> plaintexts), reasoning_depth (ARX inverse + substitution semantics), adversarial_inputs/hidden_case_generalization, quantitative_correctness (byte-exact lines).
